How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
menu
Standard in-stock orders received Monday through Friday before 2:00 PM ET are typically processed and shipped within three business days. Once your order ships, a tracking number is automatically generated and sent to your email.
If your order includes custom engraving, please allow 14 to 18 business days for processing before it ships. If you added gift wrapping, it adds an extra business day.
